verdict.rationale: Brex Bill Pay covers invoice capture (AI extracts itemized detail and matches PO), configurable multi-level approval routing by amount/vendor/role, vendor onboarding via secure payment-detail links, and payment via virtual card, ACH, checks, or wires from a Brex or external bank account — all in one platform, backed by both marketing docs and API endpoints (vendor creation, payments API). missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification of AP workflow reliability (only vendor docs, no third-party case study or user report specific to bill pay), and detail on check-payment mechanics/timing.
